anchors.applicability: Medium-density STM32F103x8/xB; actual revision not observed. Used-mode errata require explicit applicability review before physical qualification.
anchors.usart2_profile: ES096 Rev15 section2.3.9: receive-only TE0 TX pad cannot share another alternate output. The maintained profile always uses TE+RE with exclusive PA2/PA3 leases. Stop restores input/analog only after withdrawal. RX-only and a complete errata audit are not claimed.
anchors.i2c_selected_profile: ES096 Rev15 2.8.1 highest-priority IRQ0 service; 2.8.2 protected receive STOP/data windows; 2.8.5 excludes88..100kHz repeated-START, selected nominal80kHz. BUSY/low lines reject; analog-filter GPIO reset workaround and physical timing are not silently inferred.
anchors.flash: ES0962.2.11: BSYonecycledelay afterSTRT; controlreadandDSB beforestatuspoll. Physicaltimingunqualified.
anchors.debug_identity_access: ES096 Rev15 section2.2.2 p7 and Table3: DBGMCU_IDCODE/CR are debug-mode-only; normal user software reads0, no workaround. Table2 revision0 is a real code A, so an unavailable all-zero debug read must not become an observed cut.

package_review.scope: LQFP64 package inventory only; other densities and packages are excluded.
